items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: One time I had an offer from Joe Venuti when he was in town here.

ctx.x: That's fun. Do you have an office to play with big bands away from here?

Yeah, I had quite a bit of office. One time I had an offer from Joe Venuti when he was in town here. And, of course, I had several individual offerings out of town at different clubs that hang over in San Francisco. They wanted me out there a couple of times. Joe Delaney wanted to vote for me in New York just recently. But I never could make up my mind. In fact, not that I could make up my mind, circumstances just wouldn't let me go. So here I am still in New Orleans.
Well, I think that just about finishes it off for a day. We'll have to come back again for the time, huh? Alright. It's fine, man. It's good. .
